contexts.text: Their webs shall not become garments (). Here webs, and garments are predicated of the things of the understanding or thought. (Webs = feigned truths... AC 2576:12.)
The first weft of the human form...
(They said) We have woven and twisted together a web of threads of various colours (to hide our real meaning).
This is their web by which they persuade the simple...
4. There is not the... smallest weft in which the human of the spirit is not present together with the human body.
